decisions: Character cards: model_jp + desc_jp are one continuous text cut mid-word; model_en holds the first part of the sentence (<=43 bytes) and desc_en continues it from a word boundary.
Faction tags kept as written: (LB), (NZ), (CV); the Renpou tag -> (Federation).
'Protagonist' (not 'hero') for the 2nd-gen lead, who can be male or female; Kamuna's card uses the same word for consistency.
BGM cards: source credit as 'From "<official English title>"'; titles too long for one 43-byte line are split at the colon and continue in desc_en, as the Japanese does.

BGM titles: official title where reliably known (Tobe! Gundam, Arashi no Naka de Kagayaite, Silent Voice, Eternal Wind); katakana-English titles in English; other Japanese titles romanized (Hepburn, long vowels unmarked) per the slice instructions, except B-13/B-14 (same Japanese as already-translated stage titles) and B-15/B-25 (loanword title / romanization too long).
Movie cards: model_jp is a single full-width padding space -> model_en ''. Movies named after stages reuse the briefing stage-title renderings.

Ranks: junsho -> Brigadier General (glossary 'Brigadier General Blex'); chusa -> Commander (glossary role for Henken); taii -> Captain (glossary role for Amuro CCA); shosa -> Lt. Commander (same naval scale as Henken); taisa -> Colonel; soshi -> Supreme Commander (glossary).
